nodes.summary: Sends a console clear message to the appropriate console actor, broadcasting to all open client connections.

nodes.name: find_console_actor
nodes.summary: Resolves the correct console actor name for a given pipeline and optional worker ID, searching worker actors or browsing contexts as appropriate.

nodes.name: handle_network_event
nodes.summary: Coordinates network event processing by looking up or creating network event actors and delegating detailed event handling to the network handler module.

nodes.name: create_network_event_actor
nodes.summary: Creates and registers a new NetworkEventActor, storing its name in the actor_requests map for later lookup.

nodes.name: handle_create_source_actor
nodes.summary: Creates and registers source actors for JavaScript source files, managing source content retrieval and attaching sources to thread or browsing context managers.

nodes.name: handle_update_source_content
nodes.summary: Updates the content of a source actor by name, falling back to inline source content storage when needed.

nodes.name: handle_debugger_pause
nodes.summary: Handles debugger pause events by creating a PauseActor, setting frame offsets, and sending paused notifications to the connected client.

nodes.name: handle_create_frame_actor
nodes.summary: Creates frame actors for stack frames during debugger pauses, looking up source actors and registering them in a thread-scoped manager.

nodes.name: handle_create_environment_actor
nodes.summary: Creates or updates environment actors for debugger scope representations, sending the actor name back to the caller via a result channel.

nodes.name: allow_devtools_client
nodes.summary: Verifies whether an incoming TCP connection should be accepted by peeking at the first bytes for authentication and requesting embedder approval via an allow/deny token exchange.

nodes.name: handle_client
nodes.summary: Handles an individual DevTools client connection: performs initial RootActor encoding handshake, then reads and dispatches JSON packets until connection closure or error.

nodes.name: debugger_value_to_json
nodes.summary: Converts DebuggerValue types to serde_json::Value representations, handling undefined, null, uninitialized, boolean, NaN, infinity, negative zero, numeric, string, and object values with preview support.

nodes.name: network_handler.rs
nodes.summary: Handles network event dispatching for the DevTools protocol, processing request, response, and security info updates by emitting resource-available notifications through the WatcherActor.

nodes.name: Cause
nodes.summary: Represents the cause of a network request, with a type field and optional loading document URI, serialized in camelCase for the DevTools protocol.

nodes.name: handle_network_event
nodes.summary: Dispatches network event updates to connected clients by looking up the NetworkEventActor, encoding event state, and pushing resource-available/updated notifications through the WatcherActor for each event phase (request, response, security info).

nodes.name: protocol.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the DevTools remote protocol transport layer including JSON packet reading and writing over TCP streams, the DevtoolsConnection wrapper with length-prefixed packets, and ClientRequest for actor command handling with reply validation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a custom length-prefixed JSON framing format (length:data) similar to the Firefox DevTools wire protocol.

nodes.name: ActorDescription
nodes.summary: Describes a protocol actor with category, type name, and supported methods, used for introspection by DevTools clients.

nodes.name: Method
nodes.summary: Describes an actor method with name, request schema, and response schema for DevTools protocol introspection.

nodes.name: JsonPacketStream
nodes.summary: Trait defining the JSON packet stream interface with read/write methods for DevTools protocol communication over TCP.

nodes.name: DevtoolsConnection
nodes.summary: Thread-safe wrapper around a TCP stream providing JSON packet read/write, peer address lookup, and shutdown capabilities with Mutex-guarded access.

nodes.name: peer_addr
nodes.summary: Returns the peer socket address of the DevTools connection.

nodes.name: shutdown
nodes.summary: Shuts down the TCP connection in the specified direction (read, write, or both).

nodes.name: read_json_packet
nodes.summary: Reads a length-prefixed JSON packet from the TCP stream using the DevTools wire format, handling partial reads and malformed packets with descriptive errors.

nodes.name: ClientRequest
nodes.summary: Represents an individual client request from the DevTools protocol, tracking the stream, actor target, and whether it has been handled.

nodes.name: handle
nodes.summary: Processes a client request by invoking the handler function with the JSON message, returning Ok/Err based on handler result and preventing multiple handling.

nodes.name: reply
nodes.summary: Sends a reply JSON packet back to the client over the associated stream connection.

nodes.name: reply_final
nodes.summary: Sends a final reply packet and marks the request as handled, terminating the request-response exchange.

nodes.name: mark_handled
nodes.summary: Marks the client request as having been handled, preventing duplicate processing.

nodes.name: stream
nodes.summary: Returns a clone of the underlying DevtoolsConnection stream for use in continuation handlers.

nodes.name: resource.rs
nodes.summary: Defines resource tracking types for the DevTools protocol, including resource array types (Available/Updated), the ResourceAvailableReply response structure, and the ResourceAvailable trait for broadcasting resource notifications.

nodes.name: ResourceArrayType
nodes.summary: Enum distinguishing between resource types: Available (newly available resources) and Updated (previously available resources with updates).

nodes.name: ResourceAvailableReply
nodes.summary: Response struct for resource availability messages, containing the sender actor name, message type, and an array of (resource type, resources) tuples.

nodes.name: ResourceAvailable
nodes.summary: Trait providing methods for actors to broadcast resource availability and updates to connected clients via the JSON packet stream.

nodes.name: async_html.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the async HTML tokenizer that runs parsing on a background thread, communicating with the main thread via message channels. Provides the Tokenizer and Sink types that drive the HTML tree construction algorithm asynchronously.

nodes.name: encoding.rs
nodes.summary: Implements HTML document character encoding detection and decoding per the HTML Standard. Handles BOM sniffing, byte stream prescanning, meta charset detection, and XML encoding declarations.

nodes.name: html.rs
nodes.summary: Provides a synchronous HTML tokenizer wrapper and HTML serialization utilities including fragment serialization and shadow DOM serialization support.

nodes.name: Tokenizer
nodes.summary: Main async HTML tokenizer that communicates with a background parser thread via cross-thread message channels, providing feed, end, and accessor methods.

nodes.name: Sink
nodes.summary: Tree construction sink for the async HTML parser, implementing the sink interface expected by the html5ever tree builder and processing parse operations on the main thread.

nodes.name: ParseOperation
nodes.summary: Enum of all tree-building operations sent from the parser thread to the main thread, including element creation, node insertion, attribute manipulation, and shadow DOM attachment.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new async Tokenizer, setting up cross-thread channels, initializing the HTML tree builder sink, and spawning the background parser thread.

nodes.name: feed
nodes.summary: Feeds input data to the background parser thread and processes results including script execution and encoding detection responses.

nodes.name: end
nodes.summary: Signals end of input to the parser thread and processes pending operations.

nodes.name: url
nodes.summary: Returns the URL of the document being parsed.

nodes.name: set_plaintext_state
nodes.summary: Sets the parser to plaintext state by sending the SetPlainTextState message to the parser thread.

nodes.name: get_current_line
nodes.summary: Returns the current line number in the parser input.

nodes.name: process_operation
nodes.summary: Dispatches and executes tree-building operations on the main thread, handling element creation, comment insertion, doctype handling, attribute manipulation, shadow root attachment, and form association.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Main loop running on the parser background thread, receiving input chunks, driving the html5ever tokenizer and tree builder, and sending results back to the main thread.

nodes.name: append
nodes.summary: Appends a node or text as the last child of a given parent node.

nodes.name: get_template_contents
nodes.summary: Retrieves the DocumentFragment contents of an HTMLTemplateElement for use as the insertion point.

nodes.name: create_element
nodes.summary: Creates a DOM element from parser tokens with the given name, attributes, and flags, including custom element support.

nodes.name: associate_with_form
nodes.summary: Associates form-associated elements with their form owner during parser-inserted element processing.

nodes.name: append_before_sibling
nodes.summary: Sink method to insert a child before a sibling node in the tree, used by the tree construction algorithm.

nodes.name: append_based_on_parent_node
nodes.summary: Appends a child to its parent, handling form-association for elements inserted during tree construction.

nodes.name: append_doctype_to_document
nodes.summary: Creates and appends a DocumentType node to the document during tree construction.

nodes.name: add_attrs_if_missing
nodes.summary: Adds attributes to an element only if they are not already present, used for duplicate attribute handling during tree construction.

nodes.name: attach_declarative_shadow
nodes.summary: Attaches a declarative shadow root to a template element during tree construction, handling the serialized form parse.

nodes.name: DetectingState
nodes.summary: State machine for the initial encoding detection phase, buffering bytes and attempting BOM sniffing, prescanning, and chardetng fallback.

nodes.name: DecodingState
nodes.summary: Holds the active decoder and resolved encoding once encoding determination has completed.

nodes.name: NetworkDecoderState
nodes.summary: Enum wrapping Detecting and Decoding states of the network decoder, providing a unified push-based decoding interface.

nodes.name: NetworkSink
nodes.summary: Sink that collects decoded text output from the character decoding process.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new NetworkDecoderState in the Detecting phase with optional encoding hints from content-type and container document.

nodes.name: push
nodes.summary: Pushes a chunk of bytes into the decoder, transitioning from detecting to decoding once encoding is determined.

nodes.name: finish
nodes.summary: Finalizes decoding, flushing remaining bytes through the decoder and returning the final encoding.

nodes.name: is_finished
nodes.summary: Returns whether decoding has completed.

nodes.name: decoder
nodes.summary: Returns the resolved decoder if encoding detection has completed.

nodes.name: prescan_the_byte_stream_to_determine_the_encoding
nodes.summary: Implements the HTML Standard byte stream prescan algorithm that scans for encoding hints from meta charset declarations.

nodes.name: get_xml_encoding
nodes.summary: Extracts encoding from XML declaration in the byte stream.

nodes.name: get_an_attribute
nodes.summary: Parses an attribute from the byte stream during encoding prescan, handling quoted and unquoted attribute values.

nodes.name: extract_a_character_encoding_from_a_meta_element
nodes.summary: Extracts the character encoding from a parsed meta element's attributes during byte stream prescan.

nodes.name: determine_the_character_encoding
nodes.summary: Implements the HTML Standard encoding determination algorithm, trying BOM sniffing, prescanning, XML declaration, and chardetng fallback in sequence.

nodes.name: buffer
nodes.summary: Buffers incoming bytes and triggers encoding determination with timeout-based heuristics.

nodes.name: Tokenizer
nodes.summary: Synchronous HTML tokenizer wrapper that delegates to html5ever's HtmlTokenizer and TreeBuilder for synchronous parsing scenarios.

nodes.name: SerializationIterator
nodes.summary: Iterates the DOM subtree and yields serialization commands (open/close element, serialize non-element, shadow root) for HTML serialization.

nodes.name: HtmlSerialize
nodes.summary: Wrapper type that implements the serialization trait for HTML fragment serialization.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new synchronous HTML tokenizer, initializing html5ever's tokenizer and tree builder with fragment or full document parsing support.

nodes.name: feed
nodes.summary: Feeds input to the synchronous HTML tokenizer and returns results including script handles or encoding indicators.

nodes.name: end
nodes.summary: Signals end of input to the synchronous tokenizer.

nodes.name: url
nodes.summary: Returns the URL of the document being parsed synchronously.

nodes.name: set_plaintext_state
nodes.summary: Sets the synchronous parser to plaintext state.

nodes.name: get_current_line
nodes.summary: Returns the current line number from the synchronous parser.

nodes.name: serialize_html_fragment
nodes.summary: Serializes a DOM node to HTML markup, supporting shadow DOM serialization and configurable traversal scope.

nodes.name: serialize
nodes.summary: Implements the serialization trait for HtmlSerialize delegating to serialize_html_fragment.

nodes.name: start_element
nodes.summary: Serializes an element opening tag including namespace handling and self-closing syntax for void elements.

nodes.name: handle_node_contents
nodes.summary: Pushes serialization commands for a node's children, handling shadow root contents when enabled.

nodes.name: push_node
nodes.summary: Pushes a node onto the serialization stack, expanding its children for iteration.

nodes.name: next
nodes.summary: Returns the next serialization command in the iteration, managing the serialization stack.

nodes.name: prefetch.rs
nodes.summary: Implements speculative HTML prefetching by scanning parsed tokens for external resources (scripts, stylesheets, images) and initiating early fetches to improve page load performance.

nodes.name: xml.rs
nodes.summary: Provides a synchronous XML tokenizer wrapper that delegates to the xml5 crate's XmlTokenizer and XmlTreeBuilder, adapting their output to Servo's DOM types.

nodes.name: Tokenizer
nodes.summary: Prefetch tokenizer wrapper that delegates to an html5ever HtmlTokenizer for scanning tokens.

nodes.name: PrefetchSink
nodes.summary: Sink that processes HTML tokens during prefetch scanning, identifying resource URLs and initiating speculative fetches for scripts, stylesheets, images, and fonts.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new prefetch tokenizer, initializing resource fetching context from the document's security and browsing state.

nodes.name: feed
nodes.summary: Feeds input to the inner prefetch tokenizer for scanning.

nodes.name: process_token
nodes.summary: Processes individual HTML tokens to identify external resources, extracting URLs, CORS settings, integrity metadata, and initiating speculative fetch requests for scripts and other resources.

nodes.name: Tokenizer
nodes.summary: Synchronous XML tokenizer wrapper that delegates to xml5's XmlTokenizer and XmlTreeBuilder.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new synchronous XML tokenizer, initializing the xml5 tokenizer and tree builder.

nodes.name: feed
nodes.summary: Feeds input to the XML tokenizer and processes results including script handles and encoding indicators.

nodes.name: end
nodes.summary: Signals end of input to the XML tokenizer.

nodes.name: url
nodes.summary: Returns the URL of the XML document being parsed.

nodes.name: get_current_line
nodes.summary: Returns the current line number from the XML parser.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for the Trusted Types DOM implementation, declaring and re-exporting all five trusted type submodules: TrustedHTML, TrustedScript, TrustedScriptURL, TrustedTypePolicy, and TrustedTypePolicyFactory.

nodes.name: trustedhtml.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the TrustedHTML DOM type, a W3C Trusted Types wrapper for HTML strings that prevents cross-site scripting by ensuring HTML content originates from a trusted policy.

nodes.name: trustedscripturl.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the TrustedScriptURL DOM type, a W3C Trusted Types wrapper for script URL strings used in src attributes of script-like elements.

nodes.name: trustedtypepolicy.rs
nodes.summary: Implements TrustedTypePolicy and the TrustedType enum, defining createHTML, createScript, and createScriptURL callback policies that sanitize or transform untrusted inputs into trusted types.

nodes.name: TrustedHTML
nodes.summary: DOM wrapper for trusted HTML strings, implementing the W3C TrustedHTML interface with data access, stringification, JSON serialization, and type-safe conversion from user input.

nodes.name: TrustedScriptURL
nodes.summary: DOM wrapper for trusted script URL strings, implementing the W3C TrustedScriptURL interface with data access and trusted type compliance.

nodes.name: TrustedTypePolicy
nodes.summary: Defines a named trusted type policy with createHTML, createScript, and createScriptURL callback functions that transform untrusted inputs into trusted type objects.

nodes.name: TrustedType
nodes.summary: Enumeration of the three trusted type variants (TrustedHTML, TrustedScript, TrustedScriptURL) used for IDL type matching in policy enforcement.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new TrustedHTML DOM object, wrapping the data string in a DOM reflector with the global context.

nodes.name: get_trusted_type_compliant_string
nodes.summary: Validates and extracts a trusted HTML string from input, delegating to TrustedTypePolicyFactory for policy enforcement when the input is a plain string.

nodes.name: data
nodes.summary: Accessor that returns the underlying trusted HTML string data.

nodes.name: convert
nodes.summary: Converts a TrustedHTMLOrString union type into a DOMString by either extracting the trusted HTML data or returning the plain string.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new TrustedScriptURL DOM object, wrapping the URL string in a DOM reflector.

nodes.name: get_trusted_type_compliant_string
nodes.summary: Validates and extracts a trusted script URL string from input, delegating to TrustedTypePolicyFactory for policy enforcement when the input is a plain string.

nodes.name: data
nodes.summary: Accessor that returns the underlying trusted script URL string data.

nodes.name: matches_idl_trusted_type
nodes.summary: Checks whether a given IDL trusted type string matches one of the supported variants: TrustedHTML, TrustedScript, or TrustedScriptURL.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new TrustedTypePolicy DOM object with the given name and policy callback options.

nodes.name: get_trusted_type_policy_value
nodes.summary: Retrieves a trusted type value by invoking the appropriate policy callback (createHTML, createScript, or createScriptURL) and validates the result.

nodes.name: create_trusted_type
nodes.summary: Creates a trusted type object by calling the policy's callback and wrapping the returned value in the appropriate trusted type DOM wrapper.

nodes.name: CreateHTML
nodes.summary: Creates a TrustedHTML object by invoking the policy's createHTML callback, or by directly wrapping the input string.

nodes.name: CreateScript
nodes.summary: Creates a TrustedScript object by invoking the policy's createScript callback, or by directly wrapping the input string.

nodes.name: CreateScriptURL
nodes.summary: Creates a TrustedScriptURL object by invoking the policy's createScriptURL callback, or by directly wrapping the input string.

nodes.name: embedder_controls.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the request and response types for embedder-level UI controls including select elements, file pickers, context menus, input methods, and simple dialogs such as alert/confirm/prompt.

nodes.name: EmbedderControlId
nodes.summary: Identifies a specific embedder UI control instance by webview, pipeline, and epoch index.

nodes.name: EmbedderControlRequest
nodes.summary: Enum of requests from the engine to the embedder to display a UI control: select element, color picker, file picker, input method, or context menu.

nodes.name: SelectElementOption
nodes.summary: Represents a single option in a select element with an id, label, and disabled state.

nodes.name: SelectElementOptionOrOptgroup
nodes.summary: Enum representing either a select option or an optgroup containing nested options.

nodes.name: ContextMenuRequest
nodes.summary: Request to present a context menu triggered by right-clicking on web content.

nodes.name: ContextMenuItem
nodes.summary: Enum representing either a labeled context menu item with an action, or a separator.

nodes.name: ContextMenuAction
nodes.summary: Enum of context-sensitive actions available in a context menu, including navigation, clipboard, and link/image operations.

nodes.name: ContextMenuElementInformation
nodes.summary: Bitflag-based metadata about the element a context menu was activated for, indicating link, image, editable text, and selection flags.

nodes.name: InputMethodRequest
nodes.summary: Request to present an IME when an editable text element is focused, with text content and cursor position.

nodes.name: FilePickerRequest
nodes.summary: Request to display a file picker dialog with origin, current paths, filter patterns, and multiselect configuration.

nodes.name: SelectElementRequest
nodes.summary: Request to display a select element control with options, preselected indices, and multiselect configuration.

nodes.name: EmbedderControlResponse
nodes.summary: Response from the embedder to an EmbedderControlRequest, carrying the result of select, color, file, or context menu interactions.

nodes.name: SelectedFile
nodes.summary: Represents a file selected by the user in a file picker, with UUID, filename, modification time, size, and MIME type string.

nodes.name: SimpleDialogRequest
nodes.summary: Enum representing alert, confirm, or prompt dialog requests with embedded control IDs and response senders.

nodes.name: AlertResponse
nodes.summary: Response enum for alert dialogs with a single Ok variant.

nodes.name: ConfirmResponse
nodes.summary: Response enum for confirm dialogs with Ok and Cancel variants.

nodes.name: PromptResponse
nodes.summary: Response enum for prompt dialogs with Ok carrying the input string and Cancel variants.

nodes.name: input_events.rs
nodes.summary: Defines all input event types and structures for keyboard, mouse, touch, wheel, gamepad, and IME events sent from the embedder to Servo.

nodes.name: InputEvent
nodes.summary: Top-level enum of all input events sent from the embedder to Servo: editing actions, gamepad, IME, keyboard, mouse button, mouse leave, mouse move, touch, and wheel.

nodes.name: InputEventAndId
nodes.summary: Pairs an InputEvent with its InputEventId for tracking event handling outcomes.

nodes.name: EditingActionEvent
nodes.summary: Enum of editing actions that can be performed on a WebView: Copy, Cut, Paste.

nodes.name: KeyboardEvent
nodes.summary: Wraps a keyboard_types::KeyboardEvent for use in the embedder input event pipeline with constructors for various creation patterns.

nodes.name: MouseButtonEvent
nodes.summary: Represents a mouse button press or release event with action type, button, and viewport point.

nodes.name: MouseButton
nodes.summary: Enum of mouse buttons: Left, Middle, Right, Back, Forward, and Other for extended buttons.

nodes.name: MouseButtonAction
nodes.summary: Enum of mouse button actions: Down or Up.

nodes.name: MouseMoveEvent
nodes.summary: Represents a mouse move event with viewport point and a flag for compatibility events synthesized from touch input.

nodes.name: MouseLeftViewportEvent
nodes.summary: Event sent when the mouse cursor leaves the viewport, optionally due to focus moving to another iframe.

nodes.name: TouchEventType
nodes.summary: Enum of touch event types: Down, Move, Up, and Cancel.

nodes.name: TouchPointerType
nodes.summary: Enum distinguishing Pen and Touch as the physical input source for a touch event.

nodes.name: TouchEvent
nodes.summary: Represents a multi-touch event with event type, touch ID, viewport point, pointer type, and cancelable flag.

nodes.name: WheelMode
nodes.summary: Enum specifying the unit of wheel delta values: pixels, lines, or pages.

nodes.name: WheelDelta
nodes.summary: Three-dimensional scroll delta (x, y, z) with a mode specifying the unit of measurement.

nodes.name: WheelEvent
nodes.summary: Wraps a WheelDelta with a viewport point for scroll event processing.

nodes.name: ImeEvent
nodes.summary: Enum of IME events: Composition carrying a CompositionEvent, or Dismissed.

nodes.name: GamepadInputBounds
nodes.summary: Minimum and maximum values that can be reported for axis or button input from a gamepad.

nodes.name: GamepadSupportedHapticEffects
nodes.summary: Indicates whether a gamepad supports dual rumble and trigger rumble haptic effects.

nodes.name: GamepadEvent
nodes.summary: Enum of gamepad events: Connected, Disconnected, and Updated with axis or button update types.

nodes.name: GamepadUpdateType
nodes.summary: Enum identifying whether a gamepad update is an axis or button change, each carrying an index and value.

nodes.name: from
nodes.summary: Converts an InputEvent into InputEventAndId by generating a new InputEventId.

nodes.name: point
nodes.summary: Returns the viewport point associated with an InputEvent by matching on event variants, returning None for events without a point.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a KeyboardEvent wrapping the given keyboard_types::KeyboardEvent.

nodes.name: new_without_event
nodes.summary: Creates a KeyboardEvent from individual key state components including state, key, code, location, modifiers, repeat, and composing flag.

nodes.name: from_state_and_key
nodes.summary: Creates a KeyboardEvent from just a KeyState and Key, using defaults for remaining fields.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a MouseButtonEvent from action, button, and viewport point.

nodes.name: from
nodes.summary: Converts a u64 value into a MouseButton enum by matching standard button indices 0-4.

nodes.name: from
nodes.summary: Converts a MouseButton to i16 for serialization by matching each variant to its numeric code.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a MouseMoveEvent with the given viewport point and compatibility flag set to false.

nodes.name: new_compatibility_for_touch
nodes.summary: Creates a MouseMoveEvent marked as a compatibility event synthesized from touch input.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a TouchEvent from event type, touch ID, viewport point, and pointer type, with cancelable defaulting to true.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Central module crate defining all embedder-facing types including viewport geometry, cursor management, embedder messaging, media session, permissions, web resource requests, JavaScript evaluation, notifications, and webview management.

nodes.name: WebViewPoint
nodes.summary: Describes a point in a WebView, expressed either in device pixels or CSS page pixels with conversion methods.

nodes.name: WebViewRect
nodes.summary: Describes a rectangle in a WebView, expressed either in device pixels or CSS page pixels with scale conversion.

nodes.name: WebViewVector
nodes.summary: Describes a 2D vector in a WebView, expressed either in device pixels or CSS page pixels with scale conversion.

nodes.name: Scroll
nodes.summary: Enum of scroll operations: delta offset, scroll to start, or scroll to end.

nodes.name: ShutdownState
nodes.summary: Tracks whether Servo is not shutting down, in progress, or has finished shutting down.

nodes.name: Cursor
nodes.summary: Large enum of all standard cursor types including resize cursors, grab, pointer, text, zoom, and more.

nodes.name: EventLoopWaker
nodes.summary: Trait for embedders to implement, allowing Servo to request the main event loop be woken up for message processing.

nodes.name: GenericEmbedderProxy
nodes.summary: Generic sender paired with an event loop waker for dispatching messages to the embedder and waking its event loop.

nodes.name: RefreshDriver
nodes.summary: Trait for embedders to drive animation frame scheduling, e.g. via Vsync notifications.

nodes.name: AuthenticationResponse
nodes.summary: Credentials for HTTP authentication challenges with username and password fields.

nodes.name: AllowOrDeny
nodes.summary: Simple enum for binary allow/deny responses to permission requests.

nodes.name: RegisterOrUnregister
nodes.summary: Simple enum indicating whether a protocol handler should be registered or unregistered.

nodes.name: ProtocolHandlerUpdateRegistration
nodes.summary: Represents a request to register or unregister a custom protocol handler for a URL scheme.

nodes.name: ViewportDetails
nodes.summary: Viewport size and HiDPI scale factor for rendering WebView contents.

nodes.name: ScreenMetrics
nodes.summary: Screen size and available size in device-independent pixels for DOM Screen API usage.

nodes.name: PixelFormat
nodes.summary: Enum of pixel buffer formats: K8, KA8, RGB8, RGBA8, and BGRA8.

nodes.name: Image
nodes.summary: A raster image buffer with width, height, pixel format, and shared memory backing for pixel data.

nodes.name: ConsoleLogLevel
nodes.summary: Enum of console API message severity levels: Log, Debug, Info, Warn, Error, Trace, Dir.

nodes.name: BluetoothDeviceDescription
nodes.summary: Address and human-readable name for a discovered Bluetooth device.

nodes.name: EmbedderMsg
nodes.summary: Central enum of all messages sent from Servo to the embedder, covering 25+ message types including status, clipboard, cursor, media session, permissions, web resource interception, accessibility, and devtools.
nodes.languageNotes: Large enum with variants carrying WebViewId, GenericSender callbacks, and domain-specific payloads for bidirectional process communication.

nodes.name: MediaMetadata
nodes.summary: Media session metadata: title, artist, and album strings for media notifications.

nodes.name: MediaSessionPlaybackState
nodes.summary: Enum of media session playback states: None, Playing, Paused.

nodes.name: MediaPositionState
nodes.summary: Media playback position state with duration, playback rate, and current position.

nodes.name: MediaSessionEvent
nodes.summary: Enum of media session events: SetMetadata, PlaybackStateChange, SetPositionState.

nodes.name: PermissionFeature
nodes.summary: Enum of permission features matching the DOM PermissionName enum including geolocation, notifications, camera, microphone, bluetooth, screen wake lock, and gamepad.

nodes.name: InputMethodType
nodes.summary: Enum of input method editor types appropriate for editing HTML input fields: color, date, email, number, password, text, url, etc.

nodes.name: DualRumbleEffectParams
nodes.summary: Parameters for dual-rumble gamepad haptic effects: duration, start delay, strong and weak magnitude.

nodes.name: GamepadHapticEffectType
nodes.summary: Enum of gamepad haptic effect types, currently only DualRumble with parameters.

nodes.name: WebResourceRequest
nodes.summary: Details of a web resource request including method, headers, URL, destination, referrer, and flags for main frame and redirect status.

nodes.name: WebResourceResponseMsg
nodes.summary: Enum of messages for web resource interception: Start with response, SendBodyData, FinishLoad, CancelLoad, and DoNotIntercept.

nodes.name: WebResourceResponse

nodes.name: Theme

nodes.name: MediaSessionActionType

nodes.name: LoadStatus

nodes.name: Notification

nodes.name: NotificationAction

nodes.name: ScreenGeometry

nodes.name: PaintHitTestResult

nodes.name: AnimationState

nodes.name: JSValue

nodes.languageNotes: Uses bitflags crate to define LayoutDamage as a superset of RestyleDamage with layout-specific bits for inline content sizes, box damage, and descendant tracking.

nodes.name: layout_dom.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the LayoutDomTypeBundle trait and associated type aliases that map DOM node types to their concrete layout implementations, enabling parameterization of the Layout trait over a single type bundle.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses associated types to bundle multiple concrete layout trait implementations, with type aliases for extraction pending default associated types stabilization.

nodes.name: layout_element.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the LayoutElement trait providing element-level layout operations including style access, attribute retrieval, pseudo-element chain management, and type identification, along with the DangerousStyleElement trait for stylo integration.

nodes.name: layout_node.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the LayoutNode trait providing comprehensive node-level layout operations including children traversal, style resolution, selection state, image/media/canvas/SVG data access, and table span information for the Servo layout tree.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for the shared layout library, defining the main Layout trait (the layout thread engine), image animation state management, reflow request and result types, layout data structures, and re-exporting all submodule types.

nodes.name: pseudo_element_chain.rs
nodes.summary: Defines PseudoElementChain, a two-level nested pseudo-element chain data structure supporting before/after pseudo-element nesting rules with operations for adding, removing, and inspecting pseudo-elements.

nodes.name: LayoutDomTypeBundle
nodes.summary: Trait bundling all concrete Layout DOM trait implementations (LayoutNode, LayoutElement, DangerousStyleNode, DangerousStyleElement) into a single type parameter for the Layout trait.

nodes.name: LayoutElement
nodes.summary: Core trait exposing DOM elements to layout, providing methods for pseudo-element management, style data access, attribute retrieval, element type identification, and shadow DOM detection, with thread-safety constraints that forbid parent access.

nodes.name: DangerousStyleElement
nodes.summary: Unsafe trait wrapper around LayoutElement that allows parent node access, reserved exclusively for stylo and selectors integration where thread-safety invariants are managed externally.

nodes.name: LayoutNode
nodes.summary: Central layout trait exposing DOM nodes to the layout system, providing flat tree and DOM children traversal, style resolution (own, parent, selected), text content, selection state, image/media/canvas/SVG data, iframe identifiers, table spans, and form input detection.

nodes.name: DangerousStyleNode
nodes.summary: Unsafe trait wrapper around LayoutNode that allows parent node access for stylo and selectors integration, providing a layout_node() method to convert back to the safe LayoutNode API.

nodes.name: LayoutElementType
nodes.summary: Enum categorizing all supported HTML and SVG element types for the layout system, enabling element-specific layout handling for over 20 element variants including form controls and SVG elements.

nodes.name: Layout
nodes.summary: Main layout thread trait managing the full layout lifecycle including document reflow, stacking context tree construction, stylesheet management, scroll offset tracking, accessibility updates, and comprehensive query operations for element positions and computed styles.

nodes.name: AxesOverflow
nodes.summary: Struct representing scroll overflow state on both x and y axes with methods for conversion to scrollable axes and scroll container detection.

nodes.name: QueryMsg
nodes.summary: Enum defining all possible layout query message types including box area, style, text index, scroll parent, element from point, offset parent, and resize queries for script-layout communication.

nodes.name: ReflowRequest
nodes.summary: Comprehensive struct encapsulating all data for a reflow operation including document state, viewport details, animation timeline value, restyle requests, highlighted DOM nodes, and accessibility integrity checks.

nodes.name: ImageAnimationState
nodes.summary: State machine tracking animated image frame advancement including active frame index, start time, completed loops, and methods for frame duration calculation and timeline-based frame updates.

nodes.name: AnimatingImages
nodes.summary: Collection tracking image animation states across DOM nodes using a hash map from node to ImageAnimationState with dirty tracking for efficient incremental updates during reflow.

nodes.name: PseudoElementChain
nodes.summary: Data structure representing a chain of up to two nested pseudo-elements (primary and secondary), supporting before/after pseudo-element nesting rules with methods for creation, inspection, and manipulation.

nodes.name: only_layout_modes
nodes.summary: Filters a LayoutDamage value to retain only the layout-related damage bits (Relayout and below), discarding layout-specific extension bits.

nodes.name: ratio_from_view_box

nodes.name: duration_to_next_frame
nodes.summary: Calculates the time remaining until the next frame of an animated image should be displayed, accounting for frame delay and elapsed time since the current frame started.

nodes.name: unnested
nodes.summary: Creates a PseudoElementChain containing a single pseudo-element as the primary element with no secondary nesting.

nodes.name: with_pseudo
nodes.summary: Appends a pseudo-element onto an existing chain, nesting it as secondary when the primary is a before/after pseudo-element, or replacing the chain with a new single-element chain otherwise.

nodes.name: IpcBytesReceiver.recv

nodes.name: BroadcastClone

nodes.name: Serializable

nodes.name: BroadcastChannelMsg

nodes.name: SerializableFile
nodes.summary: Serializable representation of a File object with a blob implementation, name, last-modified timestamp, and webkit relative path, supporting broadcast cloning.

nodes.name: SerializableFileList
nodes.summary: A serializable list of File objects that supports broadcast cloning by cloning each contained file entry.

nodes.name: FileBlob
nodes.summary: A file-backed blob with a unique ID, file name, optional cached bytes, and size, providing accessors for ID, size, cache, and byte caching.

nodes.name: BlobImpl
nodes.summary: The Blob implementation with a blob ID, type string, data content, and optional slices, supporting creation from bytes, files, or slicing, and broadcast cloning.

nodes.name: BlobData
nodes.summary: Enumeration of blob data storage variants: file-backed, memory-backed, or sliced from a parent blob.

nodes.name: DomPoint
nodes.summary: Serializable representation of a DOM point with x, y, z, and w coordinates, supporting broadcast cloning.

nodes.name: DomRect
nodes.summary: Serializable representation of a DOM rectangle with x, y, width, and height, supporting broadcast cloning.

nodes.name: DomQuad
nodes.summary: Serializable representation of a DOM quad defined by four points (p1, p2, p3, p4), supporting broadcast cloning.

nodes.name: DomMatrix
nodes.summary: Serializable representation of a DOM matrix with matrix data and a 2D flag, supporting broadcast cloning.

nodes.name: DomException
nodes.summary: Serializable representation of a DOM exception with message and name fields, supporting broadcast cloning.

nodes.name: SerializableQuotaExceededError
nodes.summary: Serializable representation of a QuotaExceededError containing a DOM exception component, quota value, and requested amount.

nodes.name: SerializableImageBitmap
nodes.summary: Serializable representation of an ImageBitmap containing raw bitmap data, supporting broadcast cloning.

nodes.name: SerializableImageData
nodes.summary: Serializable representation of ImageData with pixel data buffer, width, and height, supporting broadcast cloning.

nodes.name: SerializableCryptoKey
nodes.summary: Serializable representation of a CryptoKey with key type, extractability flag, algorithm, usages, and a handle that supports RSA, EC, AES, HMAC, Ed25519, X25519, ML-KEM, ML-DSA, ChaCha20Poly1305, and Argon2 key types.

nodes.name: clone_values

nodes.name: transferable.rs

nodes.name: TransformStreamData

nodes.name: Transferrable
nodes.summary: Enumeration of all transferable types: ImageBitmap, MessagePort, OffscreenCanvas, ReadableStream, WritableStream, and TransformStream.

nodes.summary: The MessagePort implementation with state management (detached/enabled/disabled), entangled port tracking, message buffering, and methods for lifecycle operations including entangle, disentangle, transfer completion, incoming message handling, start, and close.

nodes.name: TransferableOffscreenCanvas
nodes.summary: Transferable representation of an OffscreenCanvas carrying its width and height dimensions.

nodes.summary: Completes a message port transfer by enabling or disabling the port based on shipping state, draining the pending task queue into the message buffer.

nodes.summary: Handles an incoming message port task by either queueing it in the message buffer if the port is already started, or creating the buffer on demand and queueing the task.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Starts the message port by enabling it and draining any queued messages from the buffer, returning them for dispatch.

nodes.name: font_descriptor.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the core font descriptor types (FontDescriptor, CSSFontFaceDescriptors, ComputedFontStyleDescriptor, LowercaseFontFamilyName) used for CSS font matching and @font-face rule processing. Provides From trait implementations to convert between style structs, computed values, and font descriptors.

nodes.name: font_identifier.rs

nodes.name: font_template.rs
nodes.summary: Implements FontTemplate and FontTemplateDescriptor types for the CSS font matching algorithm. Provides match_distance implementations for font-stretch, font-weight, and font-style according to the CSS Fonts specification, and computes variable font variation settings based on CSS descriptors.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the CSS font matching algorithm ported from Gecko, with weighted distance scoring for stretch, style, and weight axes.

nodes.name: lib.rs

nodes.name: system_font_service_proxy.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the IPC proxy for the system font service, providing a channel-based communication interface between FontContext instances and the platform-specific font service thread. Defines the message protocol, cached font template lookup with RwLock, and font key generation.

nodes.name: FontDescriptor
nodes.summary: Describes the rendering parameters of a Font instance at a particular size with applied font-variant-caps, weight, stretch, style, variation settings, and optical sizing.

nodes.name: CSSFontFaceDescriptors

nodes.name: LowercaseFontFamilyName
nodes.summary: Wrapper type around a lowercase-normalized font family name string, implementing From and Deref for seamless construction and comparison.

nodes.name: FontIdentifier
nodes.summary: Enum identifying a font source: Local (platform-specific path identifier), Web (URL from @font-face src), or ArrayBuffer (JavaScript API). Dispatches to platform-specific index and handle resolution.

nodes.name: FontTemplateRef
nodes.summary: Shared ownership wrapper around FontTemplate using Arc<AtomicRefCell>, providing interior mutability for deferred descriptor resolution.

nodes.name: FontTemplateDescriptor
nodes.summary: Describes the inherent font parameters (weight, stretch, style as ranges, and unicode range) for selecting a font from a family. Supports the CSS font matching algorithm with distance scoring.

nodes.name: FontTemplate

nodes.name: FontTemplateRefMethods
nodes.summary: Trait defining the public API surface for FontTemplateRef, including descriptor access, font matching, unicode range checking, and @font-face rule retrieval.

nodes.name: IsOblique
nodes.summary: Trait providing a method to determine if a font style is oblique (neither normal nor italic), used in the style matching distance calculation.

nodes.name: ByteIndex
nodes.summary: Newtype wrapper around usize representing a byte offset in a text run, with NumOps derive for arithmetic operations.

nodes.name: TextByteRange
nodes.summary: A range of UTF-8 byte positions in a text run, used to identify glyphs by their original character offsets. Implements Iterator and DoubleEndedIterator for iteration over byte positions.

nodes.name: FontData
nodes.summary: Stores raw font file data in an Arc<GenericSharedMemory> for zero-copy IPC transport across process boundaries.

nodes.name: FontDataAndIndex
nodes.summary: Pairs raw font data with its face index within a TrueType Collection (TTC) file, or 0 for single-font files.

nodes.name: FontDataError
nodes.summary: Simple enum indicating font data loading failure.

nodes.name: SystemFontServiceMessage
nodes.summary: Enum defining the IPC message protocol between FontContext and SystemFontService, including font template lookup, font instance creation, key generation, and memory reporting.

nodes.name: SystemFontServiceProxySender
nodes.summary: Clonable sender wrapper that can create new SystemFontServiceProxy instances with a shared IPC channel.

nodes.name: SystemFontServiceProxy
nodes.summary: Public interface for FontContext instances to communicate with the SystemFontService via IPC, with an RwLock-protected cache for font template query results.

nodes.name: index
nodes.summary: Returns the face index for the font: delegates to platform-specific LocalFontIdentifier for local fonts, or returns 0 for web and array buffer fonts.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new FontTemplate from identifier, descriptor, and optional stylesheet/font-face rule references, with validation that both stylesheet and rule are present or both absent.

nodes.name: new_for_local_web_font
nodes.summary: Creates a FontTemplate aliased from a local font with @font-face descriptor overrides, used when a CSS @font-face rule references a local() source.

nodes.name: distance_from
nodes.summary: Computes a weighted distance score between this font descriptor and a target FontDescriptor for CSS font matching, with stretch weighted at 1e8, style at 1e4, and weight at 1.

nodes.name: override_values_with_css_font_template_descriptors
nodes.summary: Overrides the font descriptor's weight, stretch, style, and unicode range with values from a CSSFontFaceDescriptors, used when applying @font-face rule properties.

nodes.name: compute_variations
nodes.summary: Computes OpenType font variation settings by combining font-variation-settings property values, @font-face rule descriptors, and implied variations from font-weight, font-stretch, and font-optical-sizing.

nodes.name: match_distance
nodes.summary: Implements the CSS font-style matching distance algorithm for oblique angles, handling normal, italic, and oblique targets with preferred direction biasing and reverse-search penalties.

nodes.name: intersect
nodes.summary: Computes the intersection of two TextByteRanges, returning an empty default range when they do not overlap.

nodes.name: exit
nodes.summary: Sends an Exit message to the system font service and waits for acknowledgment, blocking until the service confirms shutdown.

nodes.name: get_system_font_instance
nodes.summary: Requests a system font instance from the font service via IPC for a given font identifier, size, flags, and variations, with connection-liveness checking on failure.

nodes.name: find_matching_font_templates
nodes.summary: Looks up font templates matching a descriptor and family, checking an RwLock-protected cache first before querying the system font service via IPC and caching results.

nodes.name: generate_font_key

nodes.name: generate_font_instance_key

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: The README provides the essential context for understanding Servo: a prototype web browser engine written in Rust. It covers the project's goals, platform support (macOS, Linux, Windows, Android, OpenHarmony), and points to the Servo Book for detailed documentation. This is the starting point for anyone learning the codebase, as it explains why Servo exists and how its community operates.

tour.title: Workspace Architecture
tour.description: The root Cargo.toml defines the workspace structure that organizes Servo into 11 member crates, each responsible for a distinct subsystem: layout, script, net, canvas, media, SVG engine, and more. With over 250 workspace dependencies managed centrally, this file reveals how the project is decomposed into composable units and how external dependencies like Stylo (the CSS engine) are integrated through patches. Understanding this crate map is essential before exploring any single component.

tour.title: Layout Engine Entry Point
tour.description: The layout crate's lib.rs is the public API surface for the entire layout engine. It re-exports core types such as ConstraintSpace, ContainingBlock, and PropagatedBoxTreeData, which form the vocabulary used throughout the layout system. As the top-ranked code entry point by structural analysis, this file provides the bird's-eye view of how the layout crate exposes its functionality to the rest of the browser engine, including the constellation and script threads.
tour.languageLesson: Rust lib.rs files serve dual roles: they declare the crate's module tree with 'pub mod' statements and re-export selected types with 'pub use' to define the public API. Items marked 'pub(crate)' are visible within the crate but not to external consumers, creating a layered visibility boundary.

tour.title: Core Geometry and Layout Context
tour.description: The geom module defines the logical geometry types (LogicalVec2, LogicalRect, LogicalSides) that underpin all spatial calculations in the layout engine, while the context module provides the per-layout execution environment including image resolution, caching, and parallel processing configuration. These two files establish the fundamental data structures everything else builds upon -- every box position, size, and margin in Servo traces back to these geometry primitives.

tour.title: Box Tree Construction
tour.description: The construct_modern module implements the algorithm that builds the layout box tree from DOM nodes, with support for parallel processing across threads. The LayoutBoxBase type provides the fundamental per-fragment box state, tracking inline content sizes, cache management for independent formatting contexts, and fragment storage. Together these files bridge the gap between the DOM's element tree and Servo's box-based layout representation, making them the first major step in the rendering pipeline.

tour.title: CSS Flow Layout
tour.description: The flow module is the heart of CSS layout in Servo, providing the box and fragment base types along with traversal state and formatting context plumbing. The formatting_contexts module defines the independent and block formatting context types that control how elements arrange themselves according to CSS rules. Understanding flow layout is essential because it handles the default rendering mode for web content -- block elements stacking vertically, inline elements flowing horizontally, and floats disrupting the normal flow.

tour.title: Inline Text Layout
tour.description: The inline formatting context module manages line-by-line layout of text and inline-level elements, coordinating fragment placement, text runs, and line breaking. The text_run module handles the low-level details of text shaping and glyph storage, converting Unicode text into positioned glyph runs. This is where text actually gets measured and placed onto lines, handling everything from kerning to bidirectional text reordering.

tour.title: Fragment Tree and Display Lists
tour.description: The fragment tree module barrel re-exports all fragment tree types that represent the output of layout -- a tree of positioned, sized fragments ready for painting. The display list module converts this fragment tree into WebRender display items, which are the platform-agnostic drawing commands that the GPU renderer executes. This step completes the layout-to-painting pipeline: boxes are constructed, flowed, measured, and finally converted into drawable primitives.

tour.title: SVG Rendering Pipeline
tour.description: The SVG engine is a separate rendering pipeline that handles SVG content, which has fundamentally different layout and rendering rules compared to HTML. The crate's entry point declares modules for style resolution, render tree construction, and shape extraction. The render_tree module defines the SvgRenderTree and SvgRenderNode data structures that represent the SVG document as a tree of renderable nodes with viewport information. This engine processes SVG shapes (paths, circles, rectangles, polygons) through tessellation and renders them via WebRender.

tour.title: Script Engine and DOM Bindings
tour.description: The script crate is one of Servo's largest components, implementing the DOM specification and providing JavaScript runtime bindings through WebIDL code generation. Its lib.rs re-exports all public submodules covering the full DOM API: elements, events, networking (fetch), storage, canvas, WebGL, WebGPU, WebXR, and more. This crate is where the browser's JavaScript engine integration lives, and it communicates with the layout and constellation threads through well-defined IPC channels.

tour.title: Networking Stack
tour.description: The net crate implements Servo's HTTP networking stack, handling resource loading, caching, cookie management, and protocol handlers. Its lib.rs re-exports submodules for HTTP loading, WebSockets, data URLs, file URLs, and the MIME classifier. Every web page, image, stylesheet, and script that Servo loads passes through this crate, making it the gateway between the browser engine and the internet.

tour.title: Build Tooling and Toolchain
tour.description: The rust-toolchain.toml pins Servo to Rust nightly 1.95.0 with required components including clippy, rustfmt, and the rust-src and rustc-dev components needed for build system tooling. The pyproject.toml configures the Python-based build tooling (Ruff linting, Pyrefly type-checking, setuptools for Python scripts). These configuration files reveal how Servo's build is orchestrated: Rust nightly for cutting-edge language features, Python scripts for development workflow tooling (mach commands, CI, testing), and strict toolchain versioning to ensure reproducible builds.
